title: Astronaut says the moon technology was destroyed

tellings.quote: >> I'd go to the moon in a nancond. The problem is we don't have the technology to do that anymore. We used to, but we uh destroyed that technology

plain: An unnamed NASA astronaut is quoted saying he would gladly go to the moon again, but that the US no longer has the technology to do it. "We used to," he says, "but we destroyed that technology," a remark some take as a hint that something about the moon trips is being kept quiet.
